excerpt: How to Build Talent Communities for Faster and Smarter Recruitment Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. One of the most common questions asked in a job interview is also one of the most challenging: “Why should we hire you?” Employers ask this to see how well you fit the role, understand the company’s needs, and bring value to their team. In Canada’s competitive job market, where both local and international talent converge, crafting a unique, compelling response can make all the difference. This blog “Why Should We Hire You”
